title: Jacqu Cornon deathbed confession about Brown's 1956 Paris vacuum chamber test
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jacqu Cornon deathbed confession about Brown's 1956 Paris vacuum chamber test, about 1956; confession 2009 at Paris, France, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And if that's not all, we have audio of a deathbed confession from French aerospace executive Jacqu Cornon, who witnessed Brown's successful experiments in a vacuum chamber in 1956 in Paris, explicitly stating he witnessed a positive result.
